name: Son My memorial
summary: Give the morning to the memorial at Tịnh Khê, on the road that also goes to this city’s Mỹ Khê. You stop at the statue, then at the objects in the house of evidence. The bureau dates the killings to 16 March 1968 and commemorates 504 people. The same page prints smaller counts at the hamlet sites. Do not add them up. The office prints no fee. Unofficial pages disagree, so the ticket is check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A morning. Not a five-minute photo stop.
getThere: 13 km northeast, or about 12 km from cầu Trà Khúc 1.
heroCaption: The statue, full length, on the memorial grounds

notice.title: The office prints no fee
notice.body: The management page prints the phone 0255.3843222 and no fee. A taxi page prints about 20,000 VND and 7:00–17:00. A flower-shop page prints free entry and the same hours. The fee is not chosen. Those hours are not the office’s. Check on arrival.

body: Walk the 2.4 hectare memorial at xóm Khê Thuận. Stop at the statue, then go into the house of evidence. The bureau dates the killings to 16 March 1968. Inside, the page names a bronze tray with bullet holes, a child’s clothes and sandals, broken pots, a monk’s wooden bell, and a hair clip kept for eight years. Outside the fence, stelae mark the hamlet sites.

The memorial commemorates 504 people. The same page separately prints 47 at xóm Thuận Yên (thôn Tư Cung), 97 at xóm Mỹ Hội (thôn Cổ Lũy), 102 at the watchtower, and 15 at the cotton tree. Do not add those figures into a second total. The bureau’s distance is 13 km northeast of the city. The library’s is about 12 km toward the sea from cầu Trà Khúc 1. Both stay. The beach page puts the memorial 3 km from Mỹ Khê in this city.
Give it a morning. It is not a five-minute photo stop. A ceremony clock for 16 March was not printed. Check on arrival for that day.

figures.caption: The raised fist and the face, closer than the grounds
figures.alt: Close view of the Son My memorial statue, the raised fist and the figures below it

gettingThere: From the center, the bureau prints 13 km northeast. The library prints about 12 km toward the sea from cầu Trà Khúc 1. Neither page prints the minutes. A taxi fare was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the city center
legs.body: 13 km northeast on the bureau page, or about 12 km toward the sea from cầu Trà Khúc 1 on the library page. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Mỹ Khê in Quảng Ngãi
legs.body: The beach page puts the memorial 3 km away, on the same road as Sa Kỳ. The minutes are check on arrival. This Mỹ Khê is not the beach in Đà Nẵng.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the management page.
admissionNote: The management page prints the phone 0255.3843222 and no fee. A taxi page prints about 20,000 VND. A flower-shop page prints free entry. Both unofficial pages print 7:00–17:00. Those hours are not the office’s. No child rule was printed. Check on arrival.
